brief: The first 5 hires that change everything in your startup.

slots.headline:
The First Five
Hires That Make
or Break Your
Startup

slots.title: Hiring Order Matters
slots.body: Your first five hires set the DNA of your company forever. Get the sequence wrong and you burn cash. Get it right and you build an unstoppable team.

slots.title: The Product Builder
slots.body: Before you sell anything, someone has to build it. Your first hire should be a technical builder who turns your vision into working product fast and scrappy.

slots.title: The Design Thinker
slots.body: Users judge your product in seconds. A great designer crafts the experience so it feels intuitive and premium without needing a massive budget.

slots.title: The Growth Engine
slots.body: Building in silence is a trap. Hire someone obsessed with customer acquisition who can sell the dream before the product is perfect.

slots.title: The Systems Operator
slots.body: Chaos scales quickly. You need a detail-obsessed operator who builds processes and rhythm so the team executes without your constant input.

slots.title: The Customer Champion
slots.body: Retention beats acquisition in the early days. This hire turns feedback into product velocity and makes users feel genuinely heard.

slots.headline: Who Will You Hire First?
slots.body: Download our complete hiring playbook and build an A-player team from day one.
